definitions.explanation: Hasty, ill-considered thinking or action; making a decision without enough deliberation. A formal, somewhat literary word.

examples.japanese: {短慮|たんりょ}を{慎|つつし}む。
{短慮|たんりょ}な{行動|こうどう}は{後悔|こうかい}を{招|まね}く。
{一時|いちじ}の{短慮|たんりょ}から、{彼|かれ}は{大切|たいせつ}な{仕事|しごと}を{辞|や}めてしまった。
examples.english: Out of a moment's rashness, he quit his important job.

notes:
Combines {短|たん} (short) + {慮|りょ} (thought, consideration); literally 'short thinking.' A formal, somewhat literary word for acting without enough forethought.

USAGE:
- As a noun: {短慮|たんりょ}を{慎|つつし}む (to refrain from rashness)
- As a na-adjective: {短慮|たんりょ}な{判断|はんだん} (a rash judgment)

SIMILAR WORDS:
- {軽率|けいそつ}: careless; hasty — more common, emphasizes carelessness
- {浅慮|せんりょ}: shallow thinking — close synonym, also formal

cross_references.headword: {軽挙妄動|けいきょもうどう}
